properties.summary:
This three-bedroom semi-detached house in Wigan is being sold by modern method of auction. It offers spacious living accommodation with a feature fireplace, modern fitted kitchen, and bright dining room with garden access. Three versatile bedrooms include two doubles and one single, with the principal bedroom featuring fitted wardrobes.

The property benefits from a contemporary family bathroom, single garage with electric roller door, and generous enclosed rear garden with patio and outbuildings. Well-positioned near Mesnes Park and Wigan Flashes Nature Reserve, with excellent motorway access to Manchester and Liverpool. Close to highly-regarded schools including St Jude's Catholic Primary and Hawkley Hall High School.

properties.address: Poolstock Lane, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN3 5RA
properties.summary:
This three-bedroom semi-detached house on Poolstock Lane, Wigan, is being sold by online auction, with bidding managed through Secure Sale. It is leasehold and sits within easy reach of the motorway network and Wigan town centre.

The property requires a full schedule of refurbishment and includes an entrance porch, hallway, lounge, dining room, kitchen with extension, three bedrooms and a bathroom. Gardens to the front and rear and a driveway offering off-road parking are included.

properties.address: 13 Calder Drive, Maghull, Liverpool, Merseyside, L31 9DR

The property is currently occupied, though the Receivers have no details of the tenancy. Situated off Wasdale Avenue in a well-established residential area close to local amenities, schools and transport links, with Liverpool city centre approximately 11 miles away.

This three-bedroom terraced house on River Grove, Wirral, is offered freehold by auction on 25 November 2026. It has a lounge with bay window, dining room, kitchen, utility room, workshop and family bathroom, with gas central heating and double glazing.

Bebington Rail Station is about 0.75 miles away, with motorway junctions and local bus stops nearby. Buyers should note the auctioneers have not personally inspected the property and should make their own enquiries before bidding.

This three-bedroom semi-detached house is being sold through Modern Method of Auction with no onward chain, offering a reliable transaction. Well-presented and conveniently located in Lowton near schools, transport links and local amenities.

The property features a sitting room, modern fitted kitchen/diner with garden access, and three good-sized bedrooms with family bathroom. Externally, there's a driveway for off-road parking and a well-maintained private rear garden ideal for entertaining.

properties.address: St. John Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5
properties.summary:
This two-bedroom end-terrace house on St John Street, Pemberton, is offered for sale through the modern method of auction. The ground floor includes a porch, lounge, fitted kitchen, utility area and shower room, with two bedrooms and a family bathroom upstairs.

Externally there is a rear yard and a driveway, a useful feature for a terraced property in this location. The area offers good access to the M6 and M58 motorway networks. The property holds an EPC rating of C and Council Tax Band A.

This three-bedroom terraced house is situated on popular Lichfield Street in Pemberton, Wigan. It offers excellent potential for first-time buyers and investors, featuring a generous lounge, open-plan kitchen and dining area, ground floor WC, and lean-to space. Three well-proportioned bedrooms and family bathroom are on the first floor.

The property benefits from a private rear garden and on-street parking. Conveniently located near schools, local amenities, bus routes and Pemberton train station, it is sold by modern auction with no onward chain, ensuring a straightforward purchase process. Completion required within 56 days.

properties.address: Fulwood Road, Lowton, Warrington, Greater Manchester, WA3 2AX
properties.summary:
This three-bedroom semi-detached home is offered for sale by auction through secure online bidding, subject to terms and conditions. It sits within a popular Lowton development close to local shops, schools and transport links.

Inside, the ground floor offers a lounge, a kitchen opening to a conservatory with French doors to the garden, two bedrooms and a bathroom, with a third bedroom on the first floor. Outside there is a garden, a driveway and a single garage. The property has gas central heating and is listed as Council Tax Band C, with leasehold tenure noted.

This two-bedroom semi-detached bungalow on Winfrith Road in Fearnhead is offered for sale by Modern Method of Auction, with a 56-day reservation period. It includes a lounge with gas fire, a fitted kitchen, a master bedroom with fitted wardrobes, a second bedroom that could serve as a dining room, and a bathroom with walk-in shower.

Externally there is a driveway for off-road parking and a fully paved, enclosed rear garden. The property needs updating and is offered as a project for buyers wanting to tailor a home. Buyers should note the non-refundable reservation fee and buyer information pack requirements.

This two-bedroom mid-terraced house in Helsby is to be sold by online auction on 11th-12th November 2026, unless sold prior under auction terms. It offers scope for investors, landlords or owner-occupiers to refurbish and add value, with an entrance hall, separate kitchen, living room, conservatory, and a first floor with two bedrooms and a bathroom.

Externally there is a garden with room for landscaping and a driveway providing off-road parking. The village setting offers local shops, schools and countryside walks around Helsby Hill, with Frodsham nearby and road and rail links including Helsby station and the M56. The property is sold as seen and has an EPC rating of D.

This detached house will be sold by online auction on 21st October 2026. Located in the established L20 area with excellent amenities including shopping, dining and transport links.

The property comprises vacant garages with planning permission already granted (reference DC/2020/00772) for construction of a three-bedroom and two-bedroom residential home. The site is leasehold and situated in a high-yield postcode area.

This three-bedroom semi-detached house in Birkenhead is being sold by auction, offering a streamlined purchase process with completion within 56 days. The property features a modern kitchen, spacious lounge with conservatory access, three well-proportioned bedrooms, and family bathroom. Recently benefitted from a new roof.

Externally, there's an enclosed rear garden with patio area and allocated parking. Located in central Birkenhead close to amenities, transport links and schools, the property has no onward chain, making it a reliable transaction. Ideal for first-time buyers and investors seeking high-yield potential in this area.

This three-bedroom semi-detached family home sits in the heart of Eastham and is offered by Modern Method of Auction, with a reserve price that is undisclosed. Accommodation includes a porch, hall, lounge, dining room, kitchen, conservatory, three bedrooms, a family bathroom and separate WC.

Outside there is off-road parking leading to a garage, a front garden, and a rear garden with a patio, shed, lawn and mature trees. Local primary and secondary schools, shops and transport links are nearby. Buyers should note the auction terms, including a non-refundable reservation fee and a 56-day completion period.

This three-bedroom semi-detached house in the village of Elton, near Chester, is offered for sale by modern method of auction, with a reserve price undisclosed and buyer fees applying. The sale is subject to no onward chain, and the buyer must complete within 56 days.

The home offers off-street parking, a generous rear garden, and a garage conversion providing an office with its own shower room, suiting home workers or guests. Accommodation includes a lounge, kitchen/diner, three bedrooms and a family bathroom.

This recently fully renovated four-bedroom, three-bathroom terraced house is being sold by online auction on 11-12 November, unless sold prior. It has a new boiler, full rewire and rear extension, and is vacant. The current owner holds an HMO licence, though a new licence would be needed by the buyer.

The property is in Birkenhead, about three miles west of Liverpool city centre, with local shops, cafés, restaurants and rail links to the city. The vendor quotes HMO rental figures of £2,480-£2,500 per month, which have not been verified by the agent.

properties.address: Grace Road, Ellesmere Port, Cheshire, CH65 2BH
properties.summary:
This three-bedroom semi-detached freehold house on Grace Road, Ellesmere Port, is being sold via online auction through Secure Sale, subject to terms and conditions. It offers a driveway with ample on-road parking, double glazed windows, and a low-maintenance rear garden. The property is currently vacant.

Inside, a bright hallway leads to two generously sized reception rooms, a kitchen opening onto a conservatory, and upstairs a two-way landing serving three bedrooms and a family bathroom. It is within walking distance of a public green space. Council Tax Band B.

properties.address: The Rake, Bromborough, Wirral, Merseyside, CH62
properties.summary:
This spacious three-bedroom mid-terrace home is being sold by auction and offers excellent value with a 16% price reduction. The property features generous accommodation throughout, including a bright lounge, separate dining room, fitted kitchen, and versatile garden room currently used as utility space.

Upstairs are three well-proportioned bedrooms, ideal for families or home workers. Externally, the property boasts a gated rear courtyard and separate lawned garden—a substantial outdoor space rarely found with properties of this type. Conveniently located near local amenities, schools, and transport links.

This two-bedroom mid-terraced house is being sold by auction and is ideally situated in a popular residential area of Ellesmere Port, within walking distance of the town centre. The property benefits from excellent public transport links, including nearby Ellesmere Port Railway Station, making it suitable for commuters.

The home comprises a lounge, kitchen diner with integrated appliances, two bedrooms, and a bathroom. It features a private rear garden and is close to local amenities including shops and restaurants. The property offers potential for both first-time buyers and investors.

This vacant four-bedroom freehold end terrace in Liverpool, L21, is offered via Modern Method of Auction, with a secured sale running from 26th November. The property has a large yard. Buyers pay a non-refundable reservation fee of 4.5% including VAT (minimum £6,600) and should review the Auction Legal Pack before bidding.

Licensing, planning and finance are buyers' responsibilities. Any HMO or other licences are personal to the holder and do not transfer on sale. The seller may consider pre-auction offers, which would follow the same auction terms.

This two bedroom mid terrace house on Albert Street, Wigan, is vacant and in need of refurbishment. It is offered by public auction on 11 November 2026 and includes a rear yard and off-street parking. An EPC rating of D applies.

The property sits on a residential road close to local shops, with Alexandra Park nearby and Pemberton rail station providing transport links. Viewings require no booking and are scheduled on several dates in late October and early November.

This Grade II listed detached house offers generous accommodation across three storeys, with four bedrooms total. The ground floor features two reception rooms, large kitchen and shower room, whilst the first floor provides three large bedrooms and bathroom. A self-contained basement flat adds rental income potential, with separate access and its own driveway.

The property is located on Lowwood Road in Birkenhead with good access to amenities, Birkenhead Central railway station and the M53. Sold by online auction on 21st October 2026, this freehold property is situated in a high-yield investment area, with the postcode district averaging 7.8% gross yield.

This bay-fronted semi-detached house in Birkenhead is offered for sale by auction on behalf of receivers, with the auctioneers not having inspected the interior. It comprises six bedrooms, all en-suite, and a communal kitchen, and is believed to be tenanted, with any existing tenancies sold on. An estimated rental value of £34,000 per annum is quoted if fully let.

The property stands on a corner plot with gardens to the front and rear and is close to the local hospital, shops, supermarkets and a train station. Bus stops are a short walk away, with Liverpool city centre reachable in around 25 minutes. Prospective buyers should review the legal pack and arrange their own inspection before bidding.

This three-bedroom semi-detached house is being sold by auction and offers no onward chain, making it a reliable transaction. The property needs renovation and updating but is attractively priced and bursting with potential.

The home features a light hallway, two reception rooms with scope for open-plan living, and three bedrooms including two doubles with one boasting bay windows. There's a shower wet room, south-facing garden laid to lawn, and a brick storage outhouse.

This two-bedroom semi-detached house is situated in a sought-after residential cul-de-sac with no onward chain, making it a reliable transaction. The property offers spacious accommodation with a bright entrance hallway, generous lounge, well-appointed kitchen with direct garden access, and two well-proportioned bedrooms.

Externally, front and rear gardens provide excellent outdoor space, with driveway parking and garage. Ideal for first-time buyers, growing families, or investors. Sold by Modern Auction with completion required within 56 days; buyers must pay a 4.5% non-refundable reservation fee.

This freehold plot of around 0.5 acres sits in a semi-rural setting in Ince-in-Makerfield, roughly 1.7 miles south of Wigan town centre. The property is offered by online auction, with bidding running from 10 to 11 November 2026. The description notes potential for a variety of uses, subject to obtaining the necessary consents. Buyers are advised to review the legal pack and check for lot updates before bidding.

This three-bedroom semi-detached house on Exeter Road in Wallasey is offered for sale by modern auction, with bids starting at £90,000 and no onward chain. The agent estimates a potential market rent of around £950 per month following refurbishment, though achievable rent will depend on the completed standard and market conditions. The property is located in the Liscard area, close to shops, schools and transport links. Buyers should assess the condition and any proposed works through viewing and survey.

Located just off Borough Road within walking distance of Birkenhead Town Centre and the railway station.

The property is offered for sale by online auction on 9th December 2026 and would benefit from renovation. Potential future uses include retail, business, or residential accommodation, subject to appropriate planning. Buyers should note the buyer's administration fee of 1% + VAT (minimum £3,500 + VAT).

This two-bedroom end-of-terrace house in Birkenhead is being sold by online unconditional auction and requires updating throughout. It offers spacious accommodation with potential for modernisation and value addition, presented as a practical opportunity for buyers seeking a project.

The property benefits from a well-positioned location with excellent local amenities including shops, schools and leisure facilities. Strong connectivity to Liverpool city centre and wider Wirral access by road and public transport make this an attractive prospect for investors or those looking to acquire property with development potential.

Located on Farley Lane, it benefits from excellent connectivity to the M6 motorway and nearby towns, whilst maintaining a peaceful semi-rural setting with access to local amenities including a traditional pub and farm shop.

While requiring renovation, it presents an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, investors, or DIY enthusiasts to create their perfect home. You can choose every finish and fixture to your specification. Outside, there's a low-maintenance rear yard. Council Tax Band A.

This three-bedroom freehold terraced house in Ellesmere Port is being sold by the Modern Method of Auction, with a 56-day exchange and completion period. The property suits buyers seeking a renovation project, whether for a bespoke family home or a buy-to-let investment. Buyers should note that auction terms apply, including a non-refundable reservation fee and a buyer information pack fee.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hallway, lounge, dining room, and fitted kitchen on the ground floor, with two bedrooms and a family bathroom upstairs. The property sits in a small residential development accessed via Enfield Lane, within easy walking distance of Ellesmere Port town centre and its shops, cafés and pubs. Buyers should note the auction terms, including a 10% deposit (minimum £5,000) and a buyer's fee of 1.8% inc. VAT (minimum £2,400 inc. VAT), and review the Legal Pack carefully.

This three-bedroom mid-terrace house on Amaury Road in the L23 area of Liverpool is being sold via the modern method of auction, with a starting bid and reserve price. It offers a lounge, kitchen dining room, utility room, downstairs WC, family bathroom, and front and rear gardens, with on-street parking to the front. The property is unmodernised and offered with no onward chain.

The listing highlights a location within reach of local shops, schools and transport links, with access to Crosby. Buyers should note the auction terms, including a non-refundable reservation fee, a 56-day completion period and the need to complete their own due diligence. An EPC is awaiting and the property is freehold in Council Tax Band B.

It is offered at auction on 17 November 2026 with full vacant possession, and it requires modernisation throughout. Accommodation comprises three reception rooms, a kitchen and entrance hall on the ground floor, four bedrooms and a bathroom on the first floor, plus a rear garden.

The property lies close to New Brighton Rail Station and local bus services, with road links to the A554, the Kingsway Tunnel and the M53. Local shops and amenities are available in New Brighton, and Vale Park and the promenade are nearby. The EPC rating is awaited.

The property is located in a high-yield area, with properties in this postcode district achieving an average gross yield of 7.6%. A non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.5% including VAT applies to the successful buyer.

Externally, there is a driveway for off-road parking, a garage, a front garden and a good-sized rear garden. Located close to local amenities, schools and transport links, it suits investors or buyers looking for a renovation project. The property is leasehold with a lease length of 943 years.

Externally, the property benefits from a driveway, front garden, garage, and good-sized rear garden. Located close to local amenities, schools and transport links, the property has no onward chain, making it a reliable transaction. Early viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the potential.

This two-bedroom semi-detached dorma bungalow is being sold by auction. It features a spacious lounge/dining room, fitted kitchen, family bathroom, and conservatory on the ground floor, with a loft room currently used as a double bedroom with en-suite.

The property includes off-road driveway parking and both front and rear enclosed gardens. The Modern Method of Auction applies, requiring completion within 56 days of draft contract. A non-refundable Reservation Fee of 4.5% (minimum £6,600 including VAT) is payable in addition to the purchase price.

This two-bedroom terraced house in Ormskirk is for sale by auction, with bidding running from Thursday 26th November at 10am to 1pm. It offers two reception rooms with traditional fireplaces, a fitted kitchen with rear access, a generous main bedroom and a family bathroom. The property has a 924 sq ft internal area and may be suitable for conversion to three bedrooms.

Externally there is a front garden, a rear courtyard with storage and a paved garden. The home needs modernisation, and buyers should note the 10% deposit and the 4% plus VAT auction reservation fee. The property is freehold, council tax band B and has an EPC rating of D.

The property requires modernisation, so buyers should factor in updating costs. Culcheth is a village with local shops, cafes, schooling options and good motorway links. Buyers should note the buyer's information pack fee, reservation fee and AML charge.

This semi-detached house is being sold by auction and situated in a quiet, popular cul-de-sac in Warrington. It offers two well-proportioned bedrooms, a spacious open-plan living and dining area, and a fitted kitchen with garden views. The property has front and rear gardens, a family bathroom, and off-road rear parking.

The home is ideal for first-time buyers, young families, or investors seeking a low-maintenance property. Located near excellent local amenities, schools, and transport links including the M6, M60, and M62 networks, with convenient access to Birchwood shopping centre and train station.

This two-bedroom detached bungalow sits in Ormskirk, within walking distance of the town centre, shops and schools. It is being sold by auction and offered with no onward chain. The layout includes a bay-windowed lounge, a contemporary kitchen/diner opening onto the rear garden, and a modern family bathroom.

Two double bedrooms, a large loft room with a pull-down ladder and a private garden with paved seating add further space. The property has freehold tenure, council tax band information is listed, and ample parking is provided to the front.

This approximately 0.14 acre plot is being sold by auction in the popular Whelley area of Wigan. The site has previous planning permission history for 3 residential dwellings, though this permission has now expired. Any future development would require new planning consent.

The substantial parcel of land is situated in an established residential location with good access to local amenities, the Whelley Loop Line walking and cycling route, and convenient transport links including bus services and nearby railway stations. The site provides an interesting opportunity for future development subject to obtaining necessary planning permissions.

This two-bedroom detached family home is being sold by Modern Auction and benefits from having no onward chain, making it a reliable transaction. Located in popular Great Sutton, it features a lounge, dining room, kitchen, downstairs WC, and detached garage with off-road parking.

Upstairs comprises two bedrooms and a fully tiled shower room. The property is within walking distance of local shops and schools, with good travel links nearby. The rear garden provides private outdoor space, ideal for families seeking a straightforward purchase.

This three-bedroom detached house is being sold by auction with no onward chain, offering a reliable transaction. The property features a well-proportioned sitting room, separate dining room, conservatory, fitted kitchen with utility room, and additional lounge. Three generous bedrooms and two bathrooms complete the accommodation, with boarded loft space accessible via steps.

The property is in walking distance of a public park or garden, and immediate exchange of contracts is available once your bid is accepted.

This three-bedroom semi-detached house in Ormskirk requires comprehensive modernisation throughout but offers excellent potential for transformation. The property features generous proportions with multiple reception spaces, well-proportioned bedrooms, a substantial conservatory, and useful loft space.

Externally, a standout feature is the generous rear garden with a detached garage/outbuilding. Ideal for investors, developers or buyers seeking a substantial renovation project, the property will be sold by auction on 29th October.
